meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在每次回答前自动回忆之前对话中的相关记忆，并在每次对话后自动存储新的信息。记忆会保存在容器中，重启后依然存在。
howto.when: 当你在支持 Claude Code 的代理组中与 Claude 对话时，每次对话开始前和结束后都会自动触发记忆的读取和存储。

say.text: 你还记得我们上次讨论的项目计划吗？
say.note: Claude 会从记忆中调取相关上下文。

say.text: 帮我记下这个新想法：使用 Graph 数据库存储用户偏好。
say.note: Claude 会在对话结束后存储这条信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically recalls relevant past context before each response and stores new insights after each turn. Memory persists across container restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggered on each conversation turn in agent groups using the default Claude provider with Claude Code target. Memory is recalled before responding and stored after each turn.

say_en.text: Do you remember the project plan we discussed last time?
say_en.note: Claude retrieves relevant context from memory.

say_en.text: Remember this new idea: use Graph DB for user preferences.
say_en.note: Claude stores this insight after the turn.
